vis_one_image: visualize object detection results with bounding boxes, segmentation masks, keypoints, and DensePose IUV on an image
vis_one_image_opencv: construct a numpy array with detections visualized using OpenCV for bounding boxes, masks, and keypoints
vis_mask: visualize a single binary mask on an image with configurable color, alpha blending, and white border outline
vis_keypoints: visualize COCO-style keypoints and skeleton connections on an image with confidence threshold filtering and color-coded limbs
convert_from_cls_format: convert class-grouped boxes, segmentation masks, and keypoints from testing code format into flat arrays with class labels
